statement: Let n = len(enemyEnergies), m = min_{0 <= i < n} enemyEnergies[i], and S = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} enemyEnergies[i]. The function returns a result r, and: (a) if currentEnergy < m then r = 0; (b) if currentEnergy >= m then r = (currentEnergy + S - m) / m, where / is integer division (floor; the numerator is nonnegative).
preconditions: 1 <= len(enemyEnergies) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(enemyEnergies), 1 <= enemyEnergies[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= currentEnergy <= 10^9.

statement: Let m = min_{0 <= i < len(enemyEnergies)} enemyEnergies[i] and S = sum_{i=0}^{len(enemyEnergies)-1} enemyEnergies[i]. The function returns a result r and r >= S / m, where / is integer division (floor).
preconditions: 1 <= len(enemyEnergies) <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < len(enemyEnergies), 1 <= enemyEnergies[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= currentEnergy <= 10^9; currentEnergy >= m, where m = min_{0 <= i < len(enemyEnergies)} enemyEnergies[i].
